definitions.paid_incremental_order: Verified paid Steam checkout that would not have occurred without campaign; counterfactual not directly observed
definitions.utm_attributed_purchase: Steam UTM conversion event within 72 hours; association rather than causal uplift
definitions.utm_activation: Free-to-play license or Steam key redemption; not necessarily a paid Steam store order
definitions.net_partner_receipt: Assumed net cash accruing to the relevant publisher after refunds, tax, platform and partner contracts; must be attested before real use
definitions.variable_cost: Per-order customer support, services and additional fulfillment
definitions.maximum_sustainable_cac: Marginal receipt minus marginal variable cost and any reserve/fixed campaign allocation; not based on ad click counts

evidence_gates: Eligible paid Steam AppIDs and package allocation
Merchant-verified refund-adjusted net receipts matched to campaign window
Publisher contracts, tax and settlement periods
Net variable service/support costs per paid order
Randomized or otherwise credible incremental-order design
Response/nonresponse and exposure tracking; UTM attribution not used as causal proof
